definitions.explanation: A male student, typically at the university or high school level. Used in formal or institutional contexts such as statistics, regulations, and news reports.

examples.japanese: {男子学生|だんしがくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧60%だ。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男子学生|だんしがくせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{女子学生|じょしがくせい}→女子学生：25054_joshigakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ。
examples.english: At that university, the numbers of male and female students are almost equal.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧{男子学生|だんしがくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半数|はんすう}→半数：30503_hansuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたい→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: Half of the male students who responded to the survey said they want to work abroad in the future.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{男子|だんし}→男子：03425_danshi⟧ (male/boy) and ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ (student). While ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ alone is gender-neutral, {男子学生|だんしがくせい} explicitly specifies male gender. Common in formal and statistical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男子学生|だんしがくせい}{寮|りょう}: men's dormitory
- {男子学生|だんしがくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: ratio of male students
- {男子学生|だんしがくせい}{向|む}け: aimed at male students

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女子学生|じょしがくせい}→女子学生：25054_joshigakusei⟧: female student — the counterpart
- {男子生徒|だんしせいと}: male pupil — used for middle and high school students
- ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧: college student — gender-neutral
